hard_failures: Problems 5, 6, 7, and 12 require a remainder statement or written explanation, but verification checks only terminal algebraic values and declares no manual items.

errors.description: Required explanations about the exponent remainder, cancellation of imaginary parts, conjugate products, and real coefficients are absent from verification.

critical_observations: The machine gate reports zero manual items despite four explicitly written qualitative responses.
artifact_findings: All 12 independently recomputed complex-number results agree with the detailed key.
The five-page worksheet, three-page key, and two-page guide are readable and clean.
rationale: The mathematics and teaching materials are strong, but four required qualitative responses fall outside the verification boundary. That coverage failure requires rejection.
